Trimmed copies of Kubernetes source files (Apache License 2.0; each Go file keeps
its upstream license header). The zz_generated.prerelease-lifecycle.go files are
verbatim; each register.go is cut down to its license header, package clause and
GroupName constant; each OpenAPI specification (api/openapi-spec/swagger.json) is
reduced to the x-kubernetes-group-version-kind entries of the autoscaling, batch,
policy, flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io, authentication.k8s.io and
admissionregistration.k8s.io groups plus core Pod. Fixture commit ids are
synthetic. Upstream: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes
